qualifierLines: {**20 NY3d at 937} OPINION OF THE COURT

With one Justice dissenting, the Appellate Division reversed defendant's conviction, holding that defendant's plea allocution raised doubts as to his guilt of first-degree manslaughter as it tended to negate the intent element of that crime. The majority further held that County Court failed to fulfill its duty to make further inquiry to ensure the plea was knowing and voluntary (, 84 AD3d 1723, 1724 [4th Dept 2011]).
